description: The block (ms) the Streamer preset takes on the processor by itself (Block size on Auto), by the PC's physical cores: 120 ms from 7 cores, 160 ms with exactly 6, 200 ms with 5 or fewer (0: the system probe could not tell, counted as the smallest PC). Shared by Rust presets.rs (cpu_streamer_block_for_cores) and options.ts (streamerAutoBlockMs); both test against these rows.
